mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not decline by >1% over the 20-day horizon, or SPX 20d returns are not positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 250 signals rising inflation expectations, prompting investors to anticipate higher future returns and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not cross above 250 within the next month, or SPX 20d returns are not positive in >70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Both GDPC1 and HOUST exceeding their 5-month averages indicates robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST does not exceed their 5-month averages, or SPX 20d returns are not positive in >80% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS alongside falling UNRATE signals a tight labor market, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition not met, or SPX 20d returns are not positive in >75% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO crossing above 105 suggests expanding supply capacity, reducing inflationary pressures and prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not cross above 105 within the next month, or SPX 20d returns are not positive in >80% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS entering a tightening cycle (above 4.5%) signals higher interest rate expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains ≤4.5% over the next month, or SPX 20d returns are not negative in >80% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PAYEMS over 60 days indicates strengthening labor demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not rise by >2% over the 60-day horizon, or SPX 60d returns are not positive in >70% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Both GDPC1 and RSAFS exceeding their 5-month averages suggests robust demand growth, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or RSAFS does not exceed their 5-month averages, or SPX 5d returns are not positive in >90% of instances.
